exam.title: AI Transformation Leader
exam.study_prerequisites: Business decision-making or change-leadership experience plus familiarity with Microsoft 365, generative AI, Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft Foundry concepts; no coding experience is required.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Identify the business value of generative AI solutions
Identify benefits, capabilities, and opportunities for Microsoft’s AI apps and services
Identify an implementation and adoption strategy for Microsoft’s AI apps and services

review.notes: Every July 22, 2026 subobjective is mapped to a business outcome, AI/ML/automation choice, model/adaptation decision, grounding/data/security contract, Microsoft capability, build/buy/extend boundary, responsible-AI control, operating owner, adoption mechanism, economic model or pilot decision. Three integrated scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover generation versus ML and automation; pretrained/fine-tuned models; prompting, RAG, data readiness, ML lifecycle and secure AI; tokens, ROI and opportunity scoring; Copilot Chat/apps/Researcher/Analyst/Copilot Studio/Graph; Microsoft Foundry, Foundry Tools, Vision and Azure AI Search; model choice; six responsible-AI principles; AI council/adoption team/champions/workload owners; adoption barriers; licensing and consumption models; and outcome/quality/adoption/risk/cost evidence. All 12 cited URLs are cataloged: ten reachable and two Udemy pages automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records the active 45-minute exam, 4h44 official paths, one-day course, free Practice Assessment, official prep session, current Pluralsight and Udemy choices, partner learning, current Foundry terminology, and no exact verified O'Reilly, MeasureUp or Whizlabs product.
